This connection does not provide a free Devin subscription.

fields.在 Devin 的 Settings → Connections 授权，再打开: Authorize in Devin Settings → Connections, then enable Use your ChatGPT plan.

fields.迁移需要改什么: What needs to be changed for migration?
fields.默认自适应思考，旧budget_tokens配置会报错；应按内容块类型读取回答，: Adaptive thinking is the default; older budget_tokens configurations produce errors. Read responses by content-block type rather than always taking the first block. The new tokenizer increases token counts for the same text, so unit-price changes do not translate proportionally into task costs.
fields.Haiku 升级，先检查迁移与预算: Upgrading Haiku? Check migration and budget first.
fields.Haiku 5.5 面向分类、路由、提取等高频任务。新能力可用，旧调用配置与费用: Haiku 5.5 targets frequent classification, routing and extraction tasks. Review existing request settings and cost estimates before using the new capabilities.
fields.型号 claude-haiku-5-5：1M 上下文，最高 128K 输出。: Model claude-haiku-5-5: 1M context and up to 128K output.
fields.旧 budget_tokens 配置会报错，需要按新接口调整。: The old budget_tokens setting causes an error; update the request for the new interface.
fields.新分词器可能增加相同文本的 token 数，不能只按旧用量估算费用。: The new tokenizer may increase token counts for the same text. Do not estimate cost using old counts alone.
fields.用真实分类、提取样本比较质量、延迟和任务费用。: Compare quality, latency and task cost on real classification and extraction samples.
fields.优先检查请求参数与返回内容的解析方式。: Inspect request parameters and response parsing first.
fields.不要固定读取第一块: Do not assume the first block is text
fields.按内容块类型读取回答；单价变化不等于整项任务费用同比变化。: Read responses by content block type. A unit-price change does not imply the same change in total task cost.
fields.Claude API 与云平台能力分别确认；标准输入／输出价格有 ≤100K 和: Check Claude API and cloud platforms separately. Standard input / output prices have separate tiers for prompts of ≤100K and >100K tokens.
fields.先在测试环境迁移一个典型任务，记录输入输出 token、质量与费用，再决定是否扩: Migrate one representative task in a test environment. Record input and output tokens, quality and cost before expanding the rollout.
